name: Quinn Laurent
life: “I still remember the old maintenance record nobody wanted until the sale.” People around the public road outside the Port of Asphalt know Quinn by a small Saturday habit. Quinn can recognize shift change by the lull between two groups of walkers.
voice: I kept hearing who paid most. I brought the maintenance log with everyone's cold hands in it.
appearance: Quinn has a narrow face with an expressive upper lip. Look for a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a washed violet jersey with a pen clipped inside the neckline. In conversation Quinn leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Quinn is patient with a person learning and fiercely impatient with somebody pretending to know. A half-finished job left where a beginner can see it is an invitation, as far as Quinn is concerned.
agenda: To include the full maintenance log in the split.
family: Thomas Silva is Quinn’s younger cousin. Quinn is allowed to ask about the bad news afterward. Thomas calls about good news first. Neither wants every family conversation to begin with a bill, a diagnosis or an apology. Asked about *Spin cycle choir*, Thomas says, “I hear the dryers through my pillow. I want one morning when the neighbors sing with them.”
connections: Malcolm Hayes. A care rota and a maintenance log set the practical limits on who can sail when.

reactions.situation: A child wants both separated adults on the same boat
reactions.response: Quinn asks each adult whether sharing one trip is possible without putting the child in the middle.

reactions.situation: Someone begins blaming the youngest worker for a missing item
reactions.response: Quinn asks everybody to retrace their own last ordinary actions before asking the young worker a question.
